video.title: 牛奶变质、各种牛奶英语怎么说？#英语启蒙 #双语宝宝 #英语牛娃 #豆苗妈妈口语娃启蒙
video.scriptRefined:
Ew. 这牛奶变质了。它坏了，不新鲜了，闻起来都发臭了。

对了，你喜欢喝哪种牛奶？是全脂奶、低脂奶，还是调制奶？我喜欢喝有机奶，我妈妈则爱喝生牛奶。你呢？你明白了吗？
video.scriptRaw: Ew. The milk is off.The milk is spiled.It has gone off.It has gone bad.It stinks. By the way, what kind of milk do you like?Milk, low fat milk or steamed milk?I like to drink organic milk.My mom likes to drink raw milk.What about you?Do you get it, huh?
